canonical_candidate_title: The Marma and Rakhine Communities of Bangladesh: A Sociolinguistic Survey

bibliographic_identity.evidence_scope: Title, authorship, year, publisher, and place are from the secondary bibliography in Huziwara (2018), printed p. 259. No primary cover, title page, or publisher catalog record has been acquired for visual verification.

official_locator.survey_program_result: The official SIL Bangladesh chart marks Marma and Rakhaine Done.
official_locator.strongest_retrievable_official_locator: The official survey-program chart proves that SIL Bangladesh completed work labeled Marma and Rakhaine. It does not expose the cited 2007 report, its cover, extent, archive ID, file, or internal contents.

primary_artifact.verification_scope: No primary cover, title page, archive record, or report file was retrievable. No primary bibliographic or lexical topology is claimed.

primary_source_topology.unresolved_coordinates: all report pages, lists, tables, rows, columns, and cells; the report extent and any lexical appendix locations are unknown

independent_lexical_evidence.result: No located secondary source explicitly states that the 2007 report publishes lexical forms, an IPA wordlist, or a wordlist appendix.
independent_lexical_evidence.interpretive_limit: Absence of indexed evidence is not evidence that the report lacks wordlists. Lexical status remains unclassified until the primary report is inspected.

distinct_related_source.title: Consonant correspondences of Burmese, Rakhine and Marma with initial implications for historical relationships
distinct_related_source.author: Heidi A. Davis
distinct_related_source.identity: A distinct 2014 M.A. thesis, not the 2007 survey report.
distinct_related_source.lexical_limit: Its newly collected Marma and Rakhine wordlists neither establish the 2007 report's topology nor provide admissible readings for that report.

official_domain_pdf_audit.scope: Every unique successful application/pdf URL indexed across the official www.silbangladesh.org domain by the Internet Archive CDX service on 2026-08-29.

direct_publisher_filename_probe.detail: Four deterministic filenames derived from the cited title all returned the publisher site's generic HTTP 503 Technical Difficulties page; this does not establish that such files do or do not exist.

acquisition_audit.publisher_archive_result: No exact publisher archive record, cover, series identifier, extent, report file, or PDF was found by exact-title, author, language-code, official-domain, OLAC, Internet Archive, or normalized-filename searches.

request_package.candidate_title: The Marma and Rakhine Communities of Bangladesh: A Sociolinguistic Survey
request_package.candidate_authors: Loren Maggard, Sayed Ahmad, and Mridul Sangma
request_package.identity_caveat: These details are from a secondary bibliography and should be reconciled against the requested primary object.
request_package.requested_object: The complete publisher report or page-complete scan, including cover, title page, all appendices and wordlists, its archive/catalog identifier, and any redistribution or quotation terms.

acquisition_audit.next_action: Send the pinned request package to SIL Bangladesh/SIL International Publications and ask staff to search unpublished 2007 survey manuscripts as well as public catalog records. On receipt, preserve and checksum the untouched file, reconcile the primary identity and extent, render every page at 300 dpi, visually inspect every page for lexical/IPA tables, record exact physical and printed page plus cell coordinates, and only then freeze a bounded first manual cell-by-cell transcription block.

policy: No forms may be taken from the distinct 2014 thesis or any other secondary source. OCR or PDF text may locate material only after the primary report is acquired; every image-only or handwritten IPA form must be manually transcribed and verified cell-by-cell from rendered primary pages.
